_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), set 31/4/2, a sibling of 31/4/1. 24 page images (cover announces 23 printed pages; idx 23, folio 24, is BLANK, confirmed at full size). idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-22, Hindi on every odd index 1-21; odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi, and the English blocks continue even page to even page (Q36(A) idx 18->20), so the parity holds throughout. plan.txt produced no skip list, so shared questions were found by CONTENT against 2025-31-4-1: 43 rows match it word for word on this paper's own pages and carry its stem/context/options/answer/chapter/subtopic/difficulty byte for byte; 11 rows are new to this set (Q8, Q17, Q21, Q23, Q24, Q26, Q28, Q29, Q31, Q34(A), Q34(B)) and were transcribed fresh. Q31 looks like 31/4/1 Q31 but asks for a REAL image of magnification -2 (31/4/1: virtual, +2), so it is a different question. Internal choices are labelled (A)/(B) and case studies (i), (ii), (iii)(A) OR (iii)(B), as on 31/4/1. Instruction (viii) prints NO count, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms idx 3-11, per-set file, every footer X_086_31/4/2): OR after Q22, 25, 32, 34, 35, 36, 37(iii), 38(iii), 39(iii) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. The scheme's ORs inside Q22(B) (I bi-focal OR II convex lens) and Q25(B) (sulphide ore OR carbonate ore) are alternative ANSWERS, not question alternatives; the paper prints no OR there. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme page image (ms idx 2); each was also re-derived and agrees. No void note anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points on this paper are ORDINARY full stops (Q30 table: 1.62).
